newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health to buy 4.55 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health to buy 4.55 mln shrs.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems Inc said Friday it will buy 4.55 million shares of its Class B common stock from California Wellness Foundation at $24.469 per share.
The total purchase price of $111.3 million will be financed by using internal cash and existing revolving lines of credit, it said.
The company said it expects to complete the purchase in the next several days, and retire the shares to its treasury.
The company said that had the stock purchase occurred as of April 30, its shares outstanding as of that date would have been reduced to about 120.9 million.
Foundation Health said California Wellness Foundation owns 19.6 million Class B shares -- all of the Class B non-voting common stock outstanding.
Foundation Health said it can buy these shares at specified times and prices.
California Wellness was created and endowed as a result of the conversion from non-profit to for-profit status in 1992 of Foundation's Health Net subisidiary.
